scheme_name: Self-Employment Scheme: Transport/ Logistics/ Travels/ Food Court Wyaaj Sahaay
other_conditions: Applicant must have a valid driving license.
The vehicle purchased must be mortgaged (hypothecated) to the corporation.
Applicant must be willing to repay the loan in equal monthly installments over 5 years.
Only one person per family can avail of the scheme benefits.
A maximum of 5 beneficiaries per village will be selected.
benefits_summary: A 5% interest subsidy on a bank loan of up to ₹6 lakh for transport, logistics, travel and food‑court businesses.
